name: At the Doctor's Office
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on at the doctor's office — practice these key phrases out loud:
I haven't been feeling well the past few days.
Have you had any fever or chills?
I'll write you a prescription for that.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
